common.appDescription: Your study buddy: a plan for every day, practice for the topics that need it, and answers to your doubts.

feedback.errorBody: It's not you. Please try again in a moment.
feedback.offline: You're offline. Some things won't work until you're back online.
feedback.comingSoonBody: We're building this screen. Check back soon.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Pick the look that feels right for long study sessions.

indigoInk.name: Indigo Ink
indigoInk.description: Deep blue-violet for concentration. Calm for hours.

lagoon.name: Lagoon
lagoon.description: The blue-green of still water. Eases exam stress.

orchid.name: Orchid
orchid.description: Violet for imagination, with energy that never shouts.

graphite.name: Graphite
graphite.description: Quiet and clean. Color appears only when it means something.

footer.tagline: Made for learners: one calm step a day.

auth.loginIntro: Log in or create your account in one step.
auth.benefitPlan: A study plan for every day
auth.benefitPractice: Practice for the topics that need it
auth.benefitDoubts: Answers to your doubts, any time
auth.panelTitle: Study a little every day. Buddy keeps track of the rest.
auth.newHere: New here? Continuing with Google creates your account.
auth.offlineHint: You're offline. Connect to the internet to log in.
auth.googleCancelledBody: No problem. Continue with Google when you're ready.
auth.googleFailedBody: Something went wrong with Google sign-in. Please try again.

errors.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach Buddy. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: This is taking too long. Please try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notFound.title: We can't find this page
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. Let's get you back on track.

pwa.updateTitle: A new version of Buddy is ready
pwa.updateBody: Reload when you reach a good stopping point. It only takes a moment.
pwa.offlineReady: Buddy now opens even without internet
pwa.installBody: Add Buddy to your home screen. It opens like an app, even on a weak connection.
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone or iPad: tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.installed: Buddy is installed on this device.

onboarding.title: How will you study with Buddy?
onboarding.intro: Pick one to start. You can change this later.
onboarding.onMyOwnBody: Get a study plan for your exam. You can join your school or coaching later.
onboarding.withOrganizationBody: Ask to join with the code they gave you. You keep studying on your own until they accept.
onboarding.inviteHint: Got an invite email from your school or coaching? Open the link in it to join.

account.title: Your account
account.signOutEverywhereBody: Use this if you signed in on a shared or lost phone or computer. You'll need to log in again everywhere, this device too.

profile.photoDescription: Shown on your account, and to your class when you study with an Organization.
profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
profile.photoWrongType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
profile.photoTooBig: This photo is over 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
profile.detailsDescription: Your name as others see it. Your email comes from Google.
profile.emailHint: Your Google account's email. It can't be changed here.
